name: kaleidoscope-bench-text-only-subset
description: Text-only subset of the Kaleidoscope benchmark providing diverse short-form text evaluation items for language models. It is intended to measure language understanding, reasoning, and alignment across multiple task types using only textual prompts and responses. The subset removes any multimodal content to focus evaluation purely on text capabilities.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face as a community benchmark; modest adoption and used primarily for model evaluation by a niche group of practitioners.
